# General errors

Thrown as `NoResultsError`, `MultipleResultsError`, `InvalidChangesetError`, `StaleEntryError` and `NotLoadedError`, each with one message. Each entry is an identifier (`error.id`), then the message as the
error states it, where `{expression}` stands for the value of that expression in the source
(`{…}` for one too long to show), then what to do about it: the text `useFullErrorMessages(messages)`
and `explain(error)` add, where `{name}` stands for the error's parameter of that name.
See [Errors](/reference/errors).

::: v-pre

## `invalidChangeset` {#invalidchangeset}

> Could not perform &#123;details.action&#125; because the changeset is invalid. Errors: &#123;listing&#125;

Fix the input, or call the variant without "OrThrow" to get the changeset back as a Result instead of an exception.

## `multipleResults` {#multipleresults}

> Expected at most one result but got &#123;details.count&#125;&#123;inQuery(query)&#125;.

Narrow the query until it matches a single row, add limit(1), or use all().

## `noResults` {#noresults}

> Expected at least one result but got none&#123;inQuery(query)&#125;.

Use the variant without "OrThrow" (it returns null) if a missing row is not an error.

## `notLoaded` {#notloaded}

> Association "&#123;details.association&#125;" of &#123;details.schema&#125; is not loaded.

Preload it first: add .preload("&#123;association&#125;") to the query, or call repo.preload(rows, "&#123;association&#125;").

## `staleEntry` {#staleentry}

> Attempted to &#123;details.action&#125; a stale &#123;details.schema&#125; row: no row matched its primary key&#123;…&#125;.

It was deleted or changed since it was loaded. Reload it and try again, or pass allowStale: true to ignore this.

:::
